subject: English
passage: According to ancient Greek philosophy, courage was regarded as one of the four cardinal virtues. However, courage ______ viewed as just one aspect of moral character in contemporary ethics.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the use of verb forms within a sentence. A main clause requires a finite (tensed) verb to perform the action of the subject (in this case, "courage"), and this choice supplies the present tense verb "is viewed" to indicate that courage is viewed as one aspect of moral character in contemporary ethics.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because it results in an ungrammatical sentence. The nonfinite participle "having been viewed" doesn't supply the main clause with a finite verb.
